name: sudo-project-skeleton (teaching edition)
_comment_include: Unlike the lobby, _bmad-output/ and _artifacts/ ARE included here: in the skeleton they are empty {{PLACEHOLDER}} scaffolding (8 and 7 stub files), not session history. A newcomer needs that structure to exist before BMAD will write into it.
_comment_keepStructure: Drop the files, keep the structure - _artifacts/ teaches WHERE session memory goes without shipping anybody's sessions. Every folder gets a .gitkeep or git will not track it and the structure vanishes on clone. NOTE: _bmad-output is deliberately NOT here. Its files are {{PLACEHOLDER}} templates, not content, and the SessionStart hook READS _bmad-output/active-context/active-context.md - dropping it breaks the skeleton the moment it is opened.
_comment_emptyDirs: _my_resources/ is documented everywhere and shipped nowhere: the README layout diagram lists it, the workspace-standard tier table calls it Tier-2 guarded infrastructure, check_maps.py expects it, and it is named 117 times across this export - but excludeAnywhere killed the folder outright, so a newcomer got 117 pointers to nothing. It belongs in emptyDirs, NOT keepStructure: keepStructure mirrors the SOURCE subfolders, and the subfolder names under a personal area are themselves personal. Folder only, nothing inside.
_comment_exclude: AUDIT F9: this list is derived from FRESH, not copied from the lobby. Fresh vendors 15 domain skills - two the lobby does not have (gemini-live-api-dev, google-adk-python) - plus 2 domain RULES the master does not carry. Reusing the lobby's list would have shipped all four. The skeleton's own README says it carries the stack, not a product.
_comment_exclude_self: The export tooling excludes ITSELF, exactly as the lobby manifest does. It cannot survive its own substitution pass: the table's 'from' values ARE the private names, so running the pass over the manifest rewrites every row into an identity mapping ({from: YOUR_PROJECT, to: YOUR_PROJECT}). That is not cosmetic - a shipped copy in that state reports hundreds of substitutions while scrubbing NOTHING, and its leak-scan needles are scrubbed too. A privacy tool that reports success while doing no work is worse than no tool. It also masks its own leak: the scan found 0 hits here only because the manifest had scrubbed itself.
_comment_exclude_named_files: security_team_aviationchat.md carries a client name in its FILENAME on three surfaces. Its CONTENTS are scrubbed by the substitution pass, which is precisely why it slipped through: the pass rewrites what is inside a file and never renames it, and the leak scan used to read contents only. All three surfaces are named here - a per-surface list is the only honest form, because .agents/.claude/.opencode/.antigravity each hold their own copy and excluding one is not excluding the file.
_comment_excludeAnywhere: Path segments never copied, wherever they appear. frontend/ is included but is almost entirely node_modules, which this drops.
_comment_substitutions: Case-SENSITIVE, so every case variant needs its own row; the case-INSENSITIVE leak scan proves the table is complete. Fresh's own docs (AGENTS.md, docs/repo-map.md, docs/workspace-standard.md, docs/file_structure_rules/README.md) all carry domain references. clean-bmad is Fresh's old internal name and appears in the SessionStart hook string.

substitutions._note: Voice-agent names. They survive as INCIDENTAL EXAMPLES inside genuinely generic files (v3-prompt-architecture uses them as sample entities, opus-auditor says 'you are not Sully'), so these are substituted, not excluded. word:true is mandatory - Igor hides inside Rigor and Mac inside Machine.

_comment_transforms: operator-profile is floor-tier and hard-codes the owner as chair; the same generic replacement the lobby uses. The README transform is added in Phase 5, where it also gains the template-not-workshop block and the sudo lane section.

transforms._note: ADDS a file rather than replacing one - the source has no .training-mode (its owner is not a learner) but every teaching clone must start with the tutor ON.
The training rule and its command are authored in the lobby master; the skeleton needs them too so the tutor works inside a project, not only at the command center.
README gains the template-not-workshop banner and the sudo dev-loop section the original lacks.

THE agent-facing copy of the template warning. The SessionStart hook injects this file into EVERY session, so an agent opening the template sees the stop before it can start building. A README does not stop an agent; this does.

_comment_leakScan: Case-INSENSITIVE, runs every export, cannot be skipped, no exception list. Every value from a .env in the source is added automatically. _my_resources is NOT a needle - it is a structural folder name in the workspace standard that the skeleton should keep teaching; only its contents are excluded.

leakScan._note_sudomadhatter: sudomadhatter is deliberately NOT a needle - the README must carry the real clone URL or nobody can clone anything. It is the publication address, not a secret. The SUBSTITUTION still scrubs it everywhere else; transforms run AFTER substitutions, so the hand-authored README keeps the real URL.
leakScan._note_Mac: Mac was tried as a needle and REMOVED: BMAD's own project-types.csv lists 'Mac desktop app', so it fired 3 false positives AND the matching substitution corrupted vendor data to 'Chen desktop app'. A lone Mac beside Ada and Bruno identifies nobody.
